collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-03  -  A PROMISE BEFORE SUNSET SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: An older sibling promised to help a younger child finish a woven bracelet but has been assigned an unexpected chore.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: An older sibling promised to help a younger child finish a woven bracelet but has been assigned an unexpected chore.

choices.label: Explain the delay and arrange another time.
Ask another family member to help with the chore.
Work on the bracelet for a few minutes first.
Invite the child to help with an age-appropriate part of the chore.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The child is disappointed but agrees to continue after supper.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The sibling finishes the chore early and keeps the revised promise.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: With the work shared, the siblings finish the bracelet before sunset.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Nobody is available, so the older sibling returns to explain the situation.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The child learns a difficult knot and happily practices while waiting.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The chore begins late, and the sibling must explain the delay to the work leader.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: They carry light bundles together and spend the afternoon talking.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The child becomes tired, so the sibling takes them home before returning to work.
